name: Freya
title: Mistress of Fólkvangr
summary: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Goddess of love, fertility, and war, Freya often rides with the Valkyrie and stands among Asgard’s most revered deities. She is also among their busiest, as her duties and obligations have vastly expanded since the Shattering—especially as she, along with the goddess Frigg, struggle to govern the realm in the face of Odin’s growing preoccupation and ever-increasing absences.
